dialogues.speaker: Matsukawa Souzen
dialogues.text: As an officer with a duty towards Inazuma, I should naturally be upset about the current state of the nation.

dialogues.speaker: Matsukawa Souzen
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...When I think about the endless fighting between the Shogunate and the rebels, I can't even sleep or eat.

dialogues.speaker: Matsukawa Souzen
dialogues.text: If it keeps going on like this, Inazuma's finances will continue to worsen with each passing day. It's only a matter of time before it starts to affect the lives of the people...

dialogues.speaker: Matsukawa Souzen
dialogues.text: I hope that Her Excellency can act soon and fix the situation from the root of the problem herself...
